output.sentence_text: The padding token ID here is "50256", but not every "50256" in the target should be replaced.
If a target contains several "50256" values, the first one is kept because it indicates the end of text, and all remaining "50256" values are replaced with "-100".
If a target has only the end-of-text "50256", that first "50256" remains unchanged.
With this modified collate function, the inputs stay unchanged, while in the targets every "50256" after the first one is replaced by "-100".
